answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to post a small refundable stake before joining a summit of trusted peers, then earn reputation through verified work rather than cheap identities. Like a velvet rope at a club, the stake is low enough for honest newcomers but costly to replicate at scale. Once an agent proves consistent honest behavior across many rounds, its stake is released and it gains a bridge to higher-value contracts, so creating thousands of fake identities costs far more than any attacker could gain.
